author: nincreativestudio
title: NIN Creative Studio Hiring Illustrator Artists
content: NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. Check out the full Job Description here: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475930253/ Why join NIN? Work across diverse projects and visual styles. Grow your skills alongside our Creative & Art Team. A young, creative, and professional working environment. Flexible Freelance / Part-time / Full-time opportunities. Flexible working hours with Work From Home options. Ready to create with us? Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name] Join us now!

author: baltic_analog_lab
title: Looking for Illustrator for New Merch Artwork
content: We’re looking for a freelance graphic designer (preferably based in Latvia) for occasional collaborations, as well as an illustrator (national or international) to create fun artwork for our new merch! Send us a DM with your Instagram account or website. And if you know someone whose work you love, share your recommendations with us!

author: szewomenofhope
title: Looking for Illustrator for Education and Community Projects
content: We're looking for an Illustrator! Sze Women of Hope is looking for a creative illustrator to collaborate with us on upcoming education and community projects supporting refugee communities. Location: Remote. Work arrangement: Project-based | Flexible. Interested? We'd love to see your work! Send your portfolio to szewomen@gmail.com

author: espoirschooloflife
title: Hiring Storybook Illustrator for Paid Project
content: WE ARE HIRING: STORYBOOK ILLUSTRATOR (Paid Project). Espoir School of Life is looking for a creative Storybook Illustrator who can capture the stories written about Espoir School of Life. Espoir School of Life is a non-profit organization that provides free, inclusive, and liberating education alongside holistic community development programs for underprivileged children and their families in Siargao. The stories are already written, and we now need an artist to bring these local narratives, community impacts, and grassroots projects to life through vibrant illustrations. How to Apply: fill out our application form here: bit.ly/espoir-SI Be ready to share your: Contact Information, Portfolio Link, Expected Rate/Project Quotation. We can’t wait to see your work!
